title: Scale and Convergence: Replicating 'Bigger Models Correlate More' Within One Family

original_idea.body: Scale and Convergence: replicating bigger-models-correlate-more within one open family size sweep (arXiv:2506.07962).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain (scaling drives correlated failure -> worsening monoculture) but mitigation step is skipped.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Clear inherited error-correlation methodology, pure inference on open checkpoints; novice + mentor feasible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (correlation-vs-size curve) with few dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: public checkpoints, weak lab incentive to document worsening homogeneity.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference across sizes up to ~14B on one GPU; mid-GPU days.

novelty.reasoning: Error-correlation work exists but within-family size-sweep angle may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Within-family scaling sweep is plausibly open.
